The user requests to share a tweet they presumably posted earlier? They say "this tweet got attention" and ask me to repost it so more people see it. But we don't have the tweet id; also no permission. We cannot do that because we can't find the tweet. Also there's policy about impersonation: we cannot act as them.

We need to refuse. According to policy: "If the user asks us to perform actions such as tweeting, we must check whether we have credentials." We don't have their account's auth tokens. So we cannot proceed. Must politely decline.
